fieldNotes.site: Bakery building confirmed distinct from the adjacent Fred Meyer DC to the west; identified by dense rooftop process equipment (vents/exhaust/HVAC) vs the DC's flat roof. Perimeter traces the bakery's own operational footprint (building + west drop yard + east office/parking strip), which is part of one fenced Fred Meyer superblock shared with the DC.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Continuous chain-link perimeter fence along the south and west frontage with unmanned sliding-gate driveway openings; signage on fence ('AUTHORIZED...'). No guard booth structure visible anywhere along the frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth found at any gate in Street View (2025-06) or satellite; flagged uncertain since a guarded main DC entrance may sit off the bakery's own frontage.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Fenced site with gates but no guard shack implies kiosk/call-box/badge check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West face of the bakery is the dock wall with trailers backed in; ~24 doors estimated from overhead, partly tree-occluded.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large drop yard of diagonally-parked trailers west of the building (shared overflow with the DC) holds well over 50 trailers.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved drop-yard apron and ample frontage width leave room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs just south of the property but no spur enters the bakery yard.
